definitions.explanation: The number fifteen. Formed by combining {十|じゅう} (ten) and {五|ご} (five).

examples.japanese: {十五|じゅうご}{分|ふん}{待|ま}ってください。
{今日|きょう}は{十五|じゅうご}{日|にち}です。
{十五夜|じゅうごや}の{月|つき}を{見|み}ました。
examples.english: I saw the full moon on the fifteenth night.

notes: {十五夜|じゅうごや} (the fifteenth night) is culturally significant in Japan as it refers to the night of the full moon, particularly the harvest moon in autumn when people traditionally view the moon and eat rice dumplings.
